notes.md: - **M. Narasimham Committees (banking reforms):** **Committee on the Financial System (1991)** and **Committee on Banking Sector Reforms (1998)**, both chaired by **M. Narasimham**; recommended lower SLR/CRR, entry of private banks and stronger capital adequacy norms.

new.s: According to the CMS, what was the approximate cost of the 2024 Lok Sabha election?
new.x: The Centre for Media Studies put the 2024 election cost at about ₹1.35 lakh crore, against ₹60,000 crore in 2019.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: 2024 election cost ₹1.35 lakh crore (CMS)

new.s: What was the overall Labour Force Participation Rate (15+) as per the PLFS July 2026 bulletin?
new.x: The July 2026 PLFS bulletin put overall LFPR at 55.4% (up from 54.4%); WPR was 52.5% and female LFPR 34.4%.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: PLFS July 2026 LFPR 55.4%

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for free legal aid?
new.x: Article 39A, a Directive Principle, provides for equal justice and free legal aid.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: free legal aid -> Article 39A

new.s: For whom is the TG-Veer portal launched by Telangana DGP C.V. Anand meant?
new.x: TG-Veer is a single-window grievance portal for families of police martyrs, with QR-code family cards.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: TG-Veer portal -> families of police martyrs

new.s: Which is the nodal department for the Central Information Commission?
o: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances
new.x: The CIC, a statutory body set up in 2005 under the RTI Act, has DoPT as its nodal department.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: CIC nodal DoPT

new.s: The 'She Serves' initiative of the National Commission for Women promotes careers for young women in which field?
new.x: NCW's 'She Serves' promotes careers in the Armed Forces for young women; 'Yashoda AI' is on AI literacy.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: NCW She Serves -> Armed Forces careers

new.s: Under which Act is the Supreme Court Legal Services Committee constituted?
new.x: The Supreme Court Legal Services Committee is set up under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: SC Legal Services Committee -> LSA Act 1987

new.s: In which year was the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) established?
new.x: The CBI was set up in 1963; the NCRB came later, in 1986.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: CBI est. 1963

new.s: Which ancient text is associated with surgery, earning its author the title 'Father of Surgery'?
new.x: The Sushruta Samhita deals with surgery; Sushruta is called the Father of Surgery.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: Sushruta Samhita -> surgery

new.s: Under NITI Aayog's Ayurveda roadmap, integration of Ayurveda into at least how many national health systems is targeted by 2047?
new.x: The long-term phase (up to 2047) targets integration in at least 20 national health systems and insurance in at least 10 countries.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: Ayurveda roadmap long term: 20 national health systems

new.s: Who are the founders of Sarvam AI, India's first full-stack indigenous AI unicorn?
new.x: Sarvam AI (Bengaluru, 2023) was founded by Vivek Raghavan and Pratyush Kumar.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: Sarvam AI founders

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the identification of Scheduled Tribes?
new.x: Under Article 342 the President specifies the Scheduled Tribes; Article 338A deals with the NCST.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: ST identification -> Article 342

new.s: The Vyomaa Innovation Challenge for offline multilingual voice AI was launched by which body?
new.x: Bhashini ran the Vyomaa Innovation Challenge with Current AI and Kalpa Impact; its device is 'Sunno Sutra'.
new.angle: U0819-2 notes gap: Vyomaa challenge -> Bhashini

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court apply the creamy layer exclusion to OBC reservation?
new.x: Indra Sawhney (1992) introduced the creamy layer for OBCs; M. Nagaraj asked for quantifiable data on promotion quota.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: Indra Sawhney -> creamy layer for OBCs

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment inserted Article 16(4A) for reservation in promotion for SCs and STs?
new.x: The 77th Amendment (1995) inserted Article 16(4A); the 103rd (2019) gave 10% EWS reservation.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: 77th Amendment -> Art 16(4A)

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment made the National Commission for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes a multi-member body?
new.x: The 65th Amendment (1990) made it multi-member; the 89th (2003) split it into NCSC and NCST.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: 65th Amendment -> NCSC multi-member

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the All India Services?
new.x: Article 312 provides for the All India Services.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: All India Services -> Art 312

new.s: How many subjects are listed in the Eleventh Schedule for Panchayats?
new.x: The 73rd Amendment (1992) added the 11th Schedule with 29 subjects for Panchayats.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: 11th Schedule -> 29 subjects

new.s: Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 relates to which of the following?
o: National Register of Citizens in all States
new.x: Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 was inserted to give effect to the Assam Accord.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: Citizenship Act Sec 6A -> Assam Accord

new.s: What was India's Total Fertility Rate as per NFHS-5?
new.x: NFHS-5 put India's TFR at 2.0, cited in the context of the demographic change committee.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: NFHS-5 TFR 2.0

new.s: Under Section 24 of the RTI Act, information from exempted security organisations can still be sought on which matters?
new.x: Security bodies in the Second Schedule are exempt, except for information on corruption and human rights violations.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: RTI Sec 24 exemption except corruption, human rights

new.s: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
new.x: The Koshi is called the 'Sorrow of Bihar'; the Arun river of Nepal is its tributary.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: Koshi -> Sorrow of Bihar

new.s: In which year did SEBI get statutory status?
new.x: SEBI was set up on 12 April 1988 and became statutory on 30 January 1992.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: SEBI statutory 1992

new.s: Who is the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha House Committee?
new.x: Dr. K. Laxman chairs the Rajya Sabha House Committee, which handles members' accommodation and amenities.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: RS House Committee -> K. Laxman

new.s: Which body launched 'Arogya One' for planting medicinal plants along highways?
new.x: Arogya One is an NHAI initiative; phase 1 covers 17 locations, including in Andhra Pradesh.
new.angle: U0819-3 notes gap: Arogya One -> NHAI

new.s: In which year did Nagaland become a State?
new.x: Nagaland became a State in 1963; ENPO later demanded a separate Frontier Nagaland State.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Nagaland State 1963

new.s: Which hill range separates Manipur and Nagaland?
new.x: The Barail range separates Manipur and Nagaland.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Barail range separates Manipur and Nagaland

new.s: Which Census year is known as the 'Great Divide' because India's population declined that decade?
new.x: The 1921 Census showed the only decadal decline (-0.31%), linked to the 1918 influenza.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: 1921 Census Great Divide

new.s: Who conducted the first complete census of a city, Dacca, in 1830?
new.x: Henry Walter carried out the 1830 census of Dacca, the first complete census of a city.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: 1830 Dacca census -> Henry Walter

new.s: The Thorat Committee (2007) is associated with which issue?
new.x: The Thorat Committee (2007) looked into caste discrimination against SC/ST students and is cited for the UGC equity rules.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Thorat Committee -> caste discrimination

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court issue guidelines against mob lynching?
new.x: Tehseen Poonawalla (2018) laid down guidelines on mob lynching.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Tehseen Poonawalla -> mob lynching

new.s: Which section of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaces IPC Section 153A on promoting enmity between groups?
new.x: BNS Section 196 is the former IPC 153A; Section 299 is the former 295A.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: BNS 196 -> ex-IPC 153A

new.s: Which organism causes lymphatic filariasis?
new.x: Lymphatic filariasis is caused by Wuchereria bancrofti and spread by Culex quinquefasciatus.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: LF -> Wuchereria bancrofti

new.s: Which agency runs the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)?

new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: PMBJP -> PMBI

new.s: Which State was the top State in organ donation under Jeevandan 2025?
new.x: Telangana's Jeevandan recorded 763 transplants from 205 donors in 2025, the top State.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Jeevandan -> Telangana top in organ donation

new.s: Which body launched Sampurnata Abhiyan 2.0 for saturation in Aspirational Districts and Blocks?

new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Sampurnata Abhiyan 2.0 -> NITI Aayog

new.s: Root wilt disease of coconut is caused by which of the following?
new.x: Root wilt is caused by a phytoplasma in the phloem; first identified at Erattupetta, Kerala.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: coconut root wilt -> phytoplasma

new.s: Which High Court upheld the Bihar caste survey in 2023?

new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Bihar caste survey upheld by Patna HC

new.s: In which year was the Union Ministry of Cooperation set up?
new.x: The Ministry of Cooperation was created in 2021; its minister Amit Shah launched Bharat Taxi.
new.angle: U0819-4 notes gap: Ministry of Cooperation 2021

new.s: The Sixth Schedule of the Constitution applies to tribal areas in which States?
o: Meghalaya, Tripura, Arunachal Pradesh and Manipur

new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: Sixth Schedule States

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides grants-in-aid from the Union for the welfare of Scheduled Tribes?

new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: Art 275(1) grants for ST welfare

new.s: In which year was the Ministry of Tribal Affairs set up?
new.x: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs was set up in 1999.
new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: MoTA est. 1999

new.s: On which date was President's Rule imposed in Manipur after Chief Minister N. Biren Singh resigned?

new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: Manipur President's Rule 13 Feb 2025

new.s: Zokhawthar, a gateway for trade with Myanmar, is in which State?
new.x: Zokhawthar is in Mizoram; Moreh is the gateway in Manipur.

new.s: Which Law Commission report (February 2024) reviewed the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897?
new.x: The 286th Report reviewed the Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897; 285th was on criminal defamation.
new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: 286th report -> Epidemic Diseases Act

new.s: What is the maximum fine for major offences such as selling spurious or unregistered seeds under the Draft Seeds Bill, 2025?
new.x: Minor offences carry up to ₹2 lakh; major offences up to ₹30 lakh, with cancellation or imprisonment.
new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: Seeds Bill major penalty ₹30 lakh

new.s: Under the Unified Pension Scheme, what is the assured pension for 25 years of service?
o: 50% of last basic pay plus DA
60% of average basic pay of the last 10 months
50% of average basic pay of the last 12 months
new.x: UPS gives 50% of the average basic pay of the last 12 months for 25 years' service; OPS gave 50% of last basic plus DA.
new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: UPS assured pension 50% of average basic of last 12 months

new.s: Under which Act are drugs and cosmetics regulated in India?

new.angle: U0819-5 notes gap: Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940

new.s: Who is associated with the purity-pollution theory of the caste hierarchy?
